title: Do not upgrade the evidence.
prompt: Classify the actual support being described, rather than the confidence of its author.
hint: Read what is supplied: a finite run, a proposed precise claim, or a missing definition.

items.text: A pair of computed logistic trajectories separated by more than 0.1 during a declared 70-step run.
items.label: observation

items.text: A researcher proposes that a specified map satisfies a named chaos criterion but supplies no proof.
items.label: conjecture

items.text: The claim “this is chaos” omits the state space, criterion, and hypotheses.
items.label: underspecified

feedback.pass: Labels preserve the distance between seeing behavior, proposing a claim, and proving it.
feedback.fail: A plot is an observation. A precise unsupported proposal is a conjecture. A missing criterion leaves the claim underspecified.
